description.p: nailong is a lightweight Minecraft: Java Edition launcher written in Rust. This preview installs Minecraft 1.21.1 and NeoForge 21.1.209, then launches the game with an offline account.
It ships as a single native executable with no bundled runtime and keeps the launcher itself small.
First public preview: install and launch NeoForge 1.21.1 with an offline account.
